memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "I will proclaim the name of the Lord. Oh, praise the greatness of our God! He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he." — Deut 32:3-4 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses now bursts into praise, and gives God one of His most treasured names in Scripture: "He is the Rock." A rock is solid, unchanging, immovable, a place of shelter and security. In a world where everything shifts and crumbles, God is the Rock — steady, dependable, and utterly reliable. And Moses piles up the reasons for praise: His works are perfect, His ways are just, He is faithful, He does no wrong, He is upright.

Take a moment to let each of these truths settle. Everything God does is perfect — not most things, everything. All His ways are just — even the ones we do not understand. He is faithful and "does no wrong." When life feels chaotic and unfair, when we cannot make sense of what is happening, this is our anchor: God is a Rock who never fails, and He is always right, even when we cannot see how.

This is a truth to cling to in the storms. Our feelings shift, our circumstances change, our understanding falls short. But the Rock does not move. His character remains perfect and just through every season.

And this Rock has a name and a face for us: Jesus Christ. Paul says of Israel that "the rock was Christ" (1 Cor 10:4). The unchanging, faithful, perfect God has drawn near to us in His Son, the sure foundation on which we can build our lives (Matt 7:24-25). Whatever is shaking around you today, stand on the Rock. He is perfect, faithful, and He will not fail you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What in my life feels shaky, and how does "God is the Rock" steady me?
2. Do I trust that all God's ways are just, even when I don't understand?
3. What would it mean to build my life more firmly on Christ, the Rock?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You are my Rock — perfect in all Your works, just in all Your ways, faithful and true. When everything around me shifts, help me stand firm on You. I build my life on Christ, my sure foundation. Amen.
